title: Chicago with brother Deacon, Bill Brady and Yellow Nunez
summary: He played at 58th and State in Chicago in Bill Brady's band with his drummer brother, and with Yellow Nunez.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Did you ever work any jobs with Deacon?
My brother? Uh huh. No. I worked in Chicago with him. I worked at 58th and State in Chicago with my brother.
That's news to me. Any other New Orleans fellows with him?

blocks.s: Mrs. Joe Loyacano (wife of Joe Loyacano)
blocks.x: Eddie Williams was playing that band.

No, no. Freddie Newroth was playing trumpet. He was the New Orleans man. My brother was playing drums. I was playing trombone. Bill Brady was playing piano. And I don't remember who was playing clarinet. We only had a five piece band. I played with Yellow Nunez too in Chicago. You know Yellow Nunez? Through the records.
I don't think I met his son. Yeah. But he made a lot of records. Yeah, I played with Yellow. Yellow Nunez. Who's band was that?
That was Yellow Nunez's band. His own band.
